MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this CAV State.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this CAV State.

CAVStateID.description: Unique identifier of this CAV State instance.

CAVStateTime.description: Time this CAV State was produced.

CAVStateSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this CAV State was generated.

CAVState.description: Set of data describing the operational condition of the CAV.

BatteryState.description: Battery condition including capacity, temperature, and abnormal discharge indicators.

Value.description: Battery capacity value in the specified MeasureType.

Percentage.description: Remaining battery capacity as a percentage.

BrakeResponsiveness.description: Brake performance based on effective deceleration relative to UNECE braking regulations.

Delta.description: Difference between measured and expected deceleration (m/s²).

UNECEReferenceUsed.description: Identifier of the UNECE braking regulation used as reference.

MotorResponsiveness.description: Effective acceleration derived from available motor torque, gear ratio, wheel radius, and vehicle mass.

WheelResponsiveness.description: Traction effectiveness, slip behaviour, rotational anomalies, and mechanical integrity.

SlipRatio.description: Wheel slip ratio derived from wheel-speed sensors.

RotationalAnomaly.description: Indicates whether a rotational anomaly is detected.

MechanicalStatus.description: Description of wheel mechanical integrity status.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this CAV State in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the CAV State (plain text, max 2048 characters).
